name: Kidding
description: Jeff, aka Mr. Pickles, is an icon of children's TV. But when his family begins to implode, Jeff finds no fairy tale or fable or puppet will guide him through this crisis, which advances faster than his means to cope. The result: a kind man in a cruel world faces a slow leak of sanity as hilarious as it is heartbreaking.

videos.title: Green Means Go
videos.overview: Jeff Pickles decides it's time to talk about death on Mr. Pickles' Puppet Time. His executive producer, Seb, feels that Mr. Pickles the persona and Jeff Pickles the person need to remain separate. Deirdre punishes her daughter Maddy for not eating her veggies.

videos.title: Pusillanimous
videos.overview: Jeff makes a rash decision that could affect the ability of the show to continue. Seb strategizes how to rebuild Jeff's image. The two disagree about how Jeff can repair his family. Deirdre tries to learn more about what's happening while Maddy is at her piano lesson. Jeff's son Will decides to let loose with his new friends.

videos.title: Every Pain Needs a Name
videos.overview: Jeff tries to fix his heartbreak. Deirdre deals with her daughter's developing medical condition. Seb outlines the future of Mr. Pickles' Puppet Time without Jeff. Jeff tries to get Will off pot by giving him a hobby.

videos.title: Bye, Mom
videos.overview: Jeff deals with a one-night stand. Jill learns that Jeff has been sending money to someone behind her back and confronts him.

videos.title: The New You
videos.overview: Jeff decides to step out of his comfort zone. Seb tries to get Jeff on board with new changes for Puppet Time, as well as his ice skating show – Pickles On Ice, starring Tara Lipinski.

videos.title: The Cookie
videos.overview: Will tries to honor his brother in a unique way. Jeff decides to make some changes to Pickles on Ice. Deirdre lets her anger out on Maddy. Jeff tries to convince Vivian to continue with her treatment.

videos.title: Kintsugi
videos.overview: Jeff goes off script and starts to speak more honestly to children on Puppet Time as Seb panics that Jeff will soon have to appear on live television for the National Tree Lighting Ceremony. Deirdre and Scott get a new visitor from Japan – Mr. Pickles-San. The Pickles have Thanksgiving as a family.

videos.title: Philliam
videos.overview: Jeff meets the son of his pen pal, an inmate on death row, and decides to help him.

videos.title: LT. Pickles
videos.overview: Jeff wonders if he's having a breakdown or a breakthrough. Will gets into trouble at school. Scott confronts Deirdre about her feelings for Mr. Pickles-San. Seb decides to make a last-minute change to Pickles on Ice while Jeff is away.

videos.title: Some Day
videos.overview: Everyone in Jeff's life deals with the results of the speech Jeff made on national television.

videos.title: The Cleanest Liver in Columbus, Ohio
videos.overview: Jeff realizes that if he can tell a lie for the first time in his life he’ll get everything he’s ever wanted.

videos.title: Up, Down and Everything in Between
videos.overview: While Jill, Deirdre and Seb debate over who is to blame for Jeff's recent behavior, Jeff finds himself in the real-world version of Pickle Barrel Falls.

videos.title: I'm Listening
videos.overview: Jeff has an idea for how he can speak directly to the children of the world while Seb hands over the reins of the Pickle empire to Deirdre. After finding a book of magic spells, Will finds himself face to face with the past.

videos.title: I Wonder What Grass Tastes Like
videos.overview: After realizing that he might not have any real friends, Jeff makes a new best friend. Deirdre tries to get Puppet Time back on the air.

videos.title: Episode 3101
videos.overview: Jeff tries to teach children about change in the first episode of the 31st season of Mr. Pickles' Puppet Time.

videos.title: The Death of Fil
videos.overview: After an international incident, Jeff, Deirdre, Will and Seb attend a funeral at sea.

videos.title: The Acceptance Speech
videos.overview: Deirdre deals with a medical issue while attending Jeff's Lifetime Achievement Award ceremony. Jeff tries to be anyone but himself. Seb meets someone old and someone new.

videos.title: A Seat on the Rocket
videos.overview: Jeff decides to start a new Pickles family while Deirdre tries to get some good PR for the show.

videos.title: The Nightingale Pledge
videos.overview: Jeff learns the safest place for him is far away from everyone. Will talks to a mysterious visitor at his school. With Maddy's help, Deirdre gets a win for the show.

videos.title: The Puppet Dalai Lama
videos.overview: Jill asks Jeff a question he isn't sure if he can answer.
